text:
anya: Quick note  rehearsal for press brief tomorrow at 9:00am PT. Need final speaker matrix and which slides are 'remove-if-no-legal'.

jess: I'll run the opening narrative + live quote. Who's ready to handle follow-up data requests?

rachel: I can handle follow-ups for trade press. Kevin can take enterprise reporters.

kevin: Confirming. I'll also log reporter asks in the coverage sheet.

press-bot: [automated] rehearsal scheduled: 2026-05-05T09:00:00-07:00. Reminder -15m.

anya: Legal check: any last-minute restrictions on phrasing around "cost savings"?

legal-bot: Recommend avoiding percent reductions without product-verified numbers. Use "reduces per-token cost" language until numbers are cleared.

jess: Switching current slide text to descriptive language. Will upload new deck.

product-bot: Note: benchmark CSVs are available but product needs 3 hours to vet any distributor copies.

rachel: Good to know. We'll offer anonymized ranges during the brief and promise full CSVs under CDA after sign-off.

anya: Assignments for rehearsal: jess -> opening + quote; rachel -> Q&A triage; kevin -> logging + off-record tagging; anya -> chair and timekeeper. Legal will stand by for phrasing.

jess: Also prepping a one-paragraph boilerplate quote for press release. Posting draft now.

kevin: Coverage sheet link updated with rehearsal roles and backups: https://docs.example.com/launch/rehearsal-roster (internal).

press-bot: [automated] assets checklist: deck, one-pager, quote variants, CDA template (if requested). Missing: product final vet on CSV attachment.

anya: OK team  rehearsal at 9:00am PT sharp. If product can't vet CSVs in time we proceed with no numbers and a clear CTA for embargoed data under CDA. See you there. :white_check_mark:
